reconstruction_summary: Re-implemented agent's V1 (favourite) per-segment IMU yaw-gyro bias removal: bias_seg = mean(meas - pred) over (v>2, |delta_road|<0.01) samples in that segment; agent_pred = yaw_rate_pred_rads + bias_seg.
notes: Agent declared V1 (per-segment IMU yaw-gyro bias removal) as the only variant that improved on V0 ('per-segment IMU yaw-gyro bias removal (V1, -13%)'); no coefficient file was saved so the recipe was re-implemented analytically from the REPORT + tools/run_ladder.py. Bias is a per-segment scalar (mean of meas-pred over v>2, |delta_road|<0.01 samples). Of 545 canonical segments, 24 had no qualifying samples after the v>2 filter and contribute zero samples; another small set had qualifying samples but no straight subset (bias falls back to 0, i.e. identical to V0). Baseline_rmse_recomputed matches the cached canonical value to <1e-15. Original ladder was fit on Mach-E only; here the same recipe runs across Mach-E + F-150 Lightning, accepting leakage per the YAML.
